integrity: The proof normalizes every source inequality by its Euclidean normal length, converts radius feasibility to a difference-constraints system, enumerates every possible simple directed cycle in the special constraint graph, and derives necessary and sufficient cyclic-interval and full-cycle barriers. Tangencies follow from zero total slack around minimizing cycles. Finite active-set replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard Euclidean realization of chainlink polytopes in the natural nondegenerate parameter regime. It does not determine enclosing spheres, extremal ellipsoids, or Euclidean radii of fixed-sum chainlink sections. The complete incenter set is explicit as a shifted inequality system, but its dimension is not separately classified for every pattern of tied barriers.
title: Cyclic interval barriers determine the Euclidean inradius of every chainlink polytope
